name: Catering Manager

sections.daily_work: Plan and coordinate catered events. Manage budgets, menus, and staff. Work with clients to customize events. Ensure food safety and quality. Oversee setup and teardown.
sections.learning: Event planning, food and beverage management, budgeting, staff scheduling, food safety certification (ServSafe), customer relations, logistics coordination.
sections.pay: Entry-level typically starts around $35,000-$50,000 USD. Mid-level $50,000-$75,000. Senior managers at large companies can earn $80,000+. Verify for your region.
sections.entry_routes: Hospitality or culinary degree, food service experience, ServSafe certification, event planning internships, starting as a catering server or assistant.

try_in_real_life: Volunteer to help organize a community or school event
Create a mock catering plan: menu, budget, and timeline for 50 people
Talk to someone who works in event catering about their experience
sources: Catersource industry surveys; BLS food service management data
